test_cases.test_case: Successful login with valid credentials
preconditions: User has a registered account with valid credentials
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Signed in successfully.' and redirects to Accounts Overview

test_cases.test_case: Login attempt with incorrect password
test_cases.expected_result: An error message 'Incorrect email or password. Please try again.' is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Login attempt with maximum length username
preconditions: User has a registered account with maximum length username
steps: 2. Enter a username with maximum allowed characters
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Signed in successfully.' and redirects to Accounts Overview

test_cases.test_case: Successful registration with valid details
preconditions: User is on the registration page
steps: 1. Fill in First Name, Last Name, Street Address, City, State, ZIP Code, Phone Number, Social Security Number, Username, Password, and Confirm Password
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Account created successfully — please sign in.' and redirects to the login page

test_cases.test_case: Registration attempt with invalid email format
preconditions: User is on the registration page
steps: 1. Fill in First Name, Last Name, Street Address, City, State, ZIP Code, Phone Number, Social Security Number, invalid Username, Password, and Confirm Password
test_cases.expected_result: An error message indicating invalid email format is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Registration attempt with maximum length for First Name
preconditions: User is on the registration page
steps: 1. Fill in a First Name with maximum allowed characters
2. Fill in Last Name, Street Address, City, State, ZIP Code, Phone Number, Social Security Number, Username, Password, and Confirm Password
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Account created successfully — please sign in.' and redirects to the login page

test_cases.test_case: View Accounts Overview after login
test_cases.expected_result: User sees a table of all accounts with balances and account details

test_cases.test_case: Open a Checking account with valid initial deposit
preconditions: User has a funding account with sufficient balance
steps: 3. Enter valid Initial Deposit Amount ($25 or more)
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Account opened successfully!' and redirects to Accounts Overview

test_cases.test_case: Open a Checking account with insufficient initial deposit
preconditions: User has a funding account with sufficient balance
steps: 3. Enter Initial Deposit Amount less than $25
test_cases.expected_result: An error message indicating minimum deposit requirement is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Open a Savings account with the exact minimum deposit amount
preconditions: User has a funding account with at least $100
steps: 3. Enter exactly 100 in the Initial Deposit Amount field
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Account opened successfully!' and redirects to Accounts Overview

test_cases.test_case: Transfer funds between two internal ParaBank accounts
preconditions: At least two Checking or Savings accounts exist with sufficient balance
steps: 2. Select 'My ParaBank Account' as the transfer type
4. Select source account from the Source Account dropdown
5. Select destination account from the destination dropdown
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Transfer completed successfully.' with a transaction ID; account balances are updated accordingly

test_cases.test_case: Attempt a fund transfer with an amount exceeding the source account balance
preconditions: A Checking or Savings account exists with a known balance
steps: 2. Select 'My ParaBank Account' as the transfer type
3. Enter an amount greater than the source account balance
4. Select the source and a destination account
test_cases.expected_result: An error message 'Insufficient funds' is displayed; no transfer is processed

test_cases.test_case: Transfer funds with the exact balance of the source account
preconditions: A Checking or Savings account exists with a known balance
steps: 2. Select 'My ParaBank Account' as the transfer type
3. Enter the exact balance amount of the source account
4. Select the source and a destination account
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Transfer completed successfully.' with a transaction ID; source account balance is zero and destination account balance is updated

test_cases.test_case: Pay a bill successfully
preconditions: User has a funding account with sufficient balance
steps: 2. Fill in Payee Name, Street Address, City, State, ZIP Code, Phone Number, Payee Account Number, Payment Amount
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Payment submitted successfully.' with a reference code; account balances are updated accordingly

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to pay a bill with insufficient funds
preconditions: User has a funding account with insufficient balance
steps: 2. Fill in Payee Name, Street Address, City, State, ZIP Code, Phone Number, Payee Account Number, Payment Amount
test_cases.expected_result: An error message 'Insufficient funds' is displayed; no payment is processed

test_cases.test_case: Pay a bill with the exact balance of the source account
preconditions: User has a funding account with a known balance
steps: 2. Fill in Payee Name, Street Address, City, State, ZIP Code, Phone Number, Payee Account Number, Payment Amount equal to the source account balance
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Payment submitted successfully.' with a reference code; source account balance is zero

test_cases.test_case: Request a loan successfully
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Loan approved and created successfully!' with account details

test_cases.test_case: Request a loan with insufficient collateral
steps: 4. Enter Down Payment Amount less than 10%
test_cases.expected_result: An error message indicating 'Inadequate collateral value' is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Request a loan with the maximum allowable loan amount
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Loan approved and created successfully!' with account details

test_cases.test_case: Update contact information successfully
steps: 2. Edit First Name, Last Name, Street Address, City, State, ZIP Code, Phone Number
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Profile updated successfully.' and refreshes the data

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to update contact information with invalid ZIP Code
steps: 2. Edit ZIP Code to an invalid format
test_cases.expected_result: An error message indicating invalid ZIP Code format is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Update contact information with maximum length fields
steps: 2. Edit First Name, Last Name, Street Address, City, State, and Phone Number to maximum allowed lengths
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Profile updated successfully.' and refreshes the data

test_cases.test_case: Manage cards successfully by requesting a new card
steps: 2. Fill in Card Type, Account to Link, Shipping Address
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Card request submitted successfully.' with a tracking ID

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to request a card with incomplete address
steps: 2. Fill in Card Type, Account to Link, but leave Shipping Address incomplete
test_cases.expected_result: An error message indicating incomplete address is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Request a card with maximum length shipping address
steps: 2. Fill in Card Type, Account to Link, and Shipping Address with maximum allowed length
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Card request submitted successfully.' with a tracking ID

test_cases.test_case: Execute a trade successfully
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Trade executed successfully.' with an order ID; holdings are updated

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to execute a trade with insufficient buying power
steps: 4. Enter Quantity that exceeds buying power
test_cases.expected_result: An error message indicating insufficient buying power is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Execute a trade with maximum allowable quantity
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Trade executed successfully.' with an order ID; holdings are updated

test_cases.test_case: Generate account statement successfully
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Statement generated successfully.' with the relevant transactions displayed

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to generate statement with invalid date range
test_cases.expected_result: An error message indicating invalid date range is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Generate statement for the maximum date range
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Statement generated successfully.' with the relevant transactions displayed

test_cases.test_case: Update e-statement preferences successfully
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'e-Statement preference updated.'

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to update e-statement preferences with invalid email
test_cases.expected_result: An error message indicating invalid email format is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Update e-statement preferences with maximum length email
steps: 3. Enter maximum length valid Email Address
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'e-Statement preference updated.'

test_cases.test_case: Change password successfully
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Password changed successfully.'

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to change password with incorrect current password
test_cases.expected_result: An error message indicating incorrect current password is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Change password to maximum length password
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Password changed successfully.'

test_cases.test_case: Send a secure message successfully
steps: 2. Fill in Subject, select Category, and enter Message Body
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Message sent successfully.' with a ticket ID

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to send a secure message with missing subject
steps: 2. Leave Subject empty, select Category, and enter Message Body
test_cases.expected_result: An error message indicating subject is required is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Send a secure message with maximum length subject
steps: 2. Fill in maximum length Subject, select Category, and enter Message Body
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Message sent successfully.' with a ticket ID

test_cases.test_case: Request a callback successfully
steps: 2. Select Reason for Call, enter Preferred Date and Time Window
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Callback request submitted.' and sends an email confirmation

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to request a callback with invalid date
steps: 2. Select Reason for Call, enter a date that is not the next business day
test_cases.expected_result: An error message indicating the date must be at least the next business day is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Request a callback with maximum length phone number
steps: 2. Select Reason for Call, enter Preferred Date and Time Window, and maximum length Phone Number
test_cases.expected_result: Page shows 'Callback request submitted.' and sends an email confirmation
